title: Native account synchronization
help: Periodically apply this service's saved credentials to its core so the account recovers after a core restart. Purchases and wallet entries stay unchanged.
pauseHelp: Pausing leaves the current native account in place. The shared schedule in Overview controls checks for all services. Timing changes apply without a panel restart; already sent operations can finish.
conflict: The settings changed. Your draft is retained; refresh to load the current values.
